messages:
maria: Quick design question: in the org view should the invoice CTA live as a single sticky header button or as small per-project download links? Goal: balance discoverability vs visual noise. Mock: https://figma.com/... :mag:

jonah: lean header sticky for discoverability. Per-project links can be subtle text buttons for power users.

rebecca: perf caveat: avoid fetching full invoice line items for all projects. API should return totals + tiny sparklines; detail/CSV fetched on demand. Use intersection observer + keyboard focus to prefetch.

sam-a11y: accessibility: header CTA must have aria-label like "Download invoice for current scope" and be reachable as first TAB stop after skiplinks. Per-card links ok but ensure focus order follows DOM visual order; implement roving tabindex for arrow nav. Also fix low contrast on delta chips (needs 4.5:1).

leah: CS: customers expect download right after switching scope. Header sticky showing scope name + timeframe helps (e.g., "Download invoice (Apr 2026)"). We'll draft copy: "Download invoice (CSV, month)".

noah-analytics: analytics note: track clicks with event "invoice_download" and include scope_type+scope_id+project_id (project_id optional). Treat header clicks as scope-wide. Avoid double-counting by recording project_id null for header.

maria: implementation decision: header sticky is canonical + add subtle per-card CSV link. We'll gate behind feature flag `usage_invoice_header`. Follow-ups: @jonah update mock, @rebecca add ?prefetch=focus and X-Total-Count header, @sam-a11y provide exact ARIA strings, @noah-analytics give event schema. Plan: prototype -> 2% orgs for 2 weeks.
